purpose: Evaluate fixed V1 probability models against an independent historical closing-market benchmark without selecting parameters from the test outcomes.

development.role: already-viewed fit and OOF development only

blind_test.source: Football-Data.co.uk season files plus API-Football fixture/statistics responses
blind_test.target_rule: Use only fixtures with at least five strictly earlier same-team API-Football statistics xG observations; fixture rows and target results remain unopened until the model manifests are frozen.
blind_test.probe_exclusion: The 2024-01 API-Football capability probe rows are outside this 2022-23 cohort and are excluded by season rule.

point_in_time.xg: For each target fixture, use each team's latest five numeric xG observations with source kickoff strictly earlier than target kickoff; no post-kickoff fields, results, or target fixture statistics.
point_in_time.market: Football-Data prices are closing/aggregate observations only. They may be used as a closing-market benchmark and hypothetical closing EV; they must not be labelled as T-30/T-15 executable quotes.
point_in_time.mapping: Join by independently verified competition, season, UTC kickoff, and normalized home/away identities; ambiguous mappings are excluded and reported.

fixed_models.production: Current deployed V1 parameters at revision 1de3c1ef; no parameter changes.
fixed_models.ah_candidate: Frozen AH component-share values home_adjustment=0.208545, attack_adjustment=0.663475, defence_adjustment=-0.112027 from 8e7d654b; evaluated only as a pre-declared fixed candidate, never refit on blind rows.
fixed_models.totals_candidate: Frozen TOTALS axis fit total_goals_intercept=0.885958 and total_goals_scale=0.701191; evaluated only as a pre-declared fixed candidate, never refit on blind rows.

markets.asian_handicap: Football-Data closing AHCh plus Pinnacle closing PCAHH/PCAHA where both sides and line are present.
markets.totals: Football-Data 2.5 goal closing P>2.5/P<2.5 where both prices are present; this is a fixed 2.5 line diagnostic, not the full production ladder.

metrics.primary: paired model-vs-closing-market Brier and log loss, reported separately by market and competition
metrics.economic_diagnostic: Hypothetical closing cashflow EV and settlement P&L are descriptive only and cannot select any parameter, threshold, or model.
metrics.calibration: Reliability bins and ECE for model and proportional-devig closing market

acceptance.bootstrap: Deterministic 10000-replicate fixture-cluster bootstrap, seed 20260901, one-sided 95% upper bound.
acceptance.candidate_vs_production: For AH and TOTALS separately, candidate-minus-production mean Brier and mean log loss must both be < 0 and both one-sided upper bounds must be <= 0.
acceptance.candidate_vs_market: For AH and TOTALS separately, candidate-minus-proportional-devig Pinnacle closing mean Brier and mean log loss must both be < 0 and both one-sided upper bounds must be <= 0.
acceptance.competition_guard: Candidate Brier may not worsen by more than 0.005 in any one of the five competitions.
acceptance.combined_rule: No deployable verdict unless both AH and TOTALS pass every rule independently; results may not be pooled to compensate one market with the other.
acceptance.one_x_two: Diagnostic only and never a pass gate.

freeze_order: Freeze input manifest and model outputs without reading target result fields.
Hash and commit the frozen model artifact.
Only after that commit, open final results and compute settlement diagnostics.
failure_rules: No parameter, threshold, model-family, or admission-contract change is allowed from blind-test outcomes.
If closing odds are missing or mapping is ambiguous, report the gap; do not substitute another source or fabricate a quote.
A pass is a comparative diagnostic only; it does not grant calibration authority or authorize deployment.
A failed candidate is rejected and the next candidate requires a new preregistration and a non-overlapping cohort.
